hypothesis: V8 gains come primarily from normalization-free global moments of learned feature maps, while the BatchNorm TCN contributes small-sample variance. Removing the TCN should preserve or improve BA with fewer parameters.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain only if BA is within 0.005 of V8 with clearly lower seed/fold variance, or improves by at least 0.01. Otherwise retain the time-plus-moment V8 and conclude the temporal and global branches are complementary.
